summary: A toggle for an on/off setting with its label, description and error laid out beside it, taking part in forms.

label.note: Visible label next to the track and accessible name. Required: shadow DOM keeps an external <label for> from reaching the inner input.

hideLabel.note: Visually hides the label; it stays the accessible name. Use only when other visible text names the switch.

error.note: Error message. Setting it marks the field invalid.

value.note: Submitted with the form while on.

checked.note: Current state (on). Not reflected: the attribute is the default restored by form reset.

required.note: Native required: must be on. Adds an aria-hidden asterisk after the label.

disabled.note: Native disabled; dimmed; not submitted. A disabled fieldset ancestor also disables it without changing the attribute.

size.note: Track 32px wide (default) or 24px (sm). The label row keeps the same type size.

anatomy.name: field
anatomy.notes: Grid: track in the first column, label, description and error in the second.

anatomy.name: control
anatomy.notes: Track wrapper; positions the thumb over the native input.

anatomy.name: input
anatomy.notes: Native <input type=checkbox role=switch>; receives focus, Space and validation.

anatomy.name: thumb
anatomy.notes: The sliding knob; decorative, position follows checked.

anatomy.name: label
anatomy.notes: Native <label for> in the same shadow root.

anatomy.name: error
anatomy.notes: Persistent polite live region; text appears when invalid.

input.note: Each toggle. Native and composed, so it crosses the shadow boundary.

change.note: Toggle committed. Re-dispatched from the host because native change is not composed (NativeControl).

focus-visible.note: 3px solid ring outside the track (a translucent ring would fall under 3:1).

checked.note: Track fills with primary and the thumb moves to the end side (mirrored in RTL).

invalid.trigger: error set, or required and off after blur or a submit attempt

disabled.trigger: disabled attribute or a disabled fieldset ancestor

accessibility.accessibleNameSource: The label prop, through a native <label for> in the same shadow root.

formAssociation.note: FormAssociated + NativeControl. setFormValue(value) only while on, null while off; validity mirrored from the inner input (required -> valueMissing); formResetCallback restores the attribute default; disabled (own or a disabled fieldset) is not submitted; formStateRestore restores checked.

accessibility.targetSize: The track is under 24px high; the label beside it is part of the clickable row and the 12px gap satisfies the WCAG 2.5.8 spacing exception.
accessibility.focusRingVisible: On keyboard focus of the input; 3px ring in switch.focus-ring.color.
accessibility.missingNameWarning: Dev-only console warning, once, when label is empty.

keyboard.Tab: move focus to and from the switch
keyboard.Enter: submits the form (implicit submission; the control has no form owner in its shadow root, SB-0009); it does not toggle

aria: native checkbox with role="switch": exposes the on/off state as checked
aria-describedby -> description and error ids (same root)
required: native required; the asterisk is aria-hidden
error: sets a customError validity, so the form blocks submission
announcements: error text is announced once when it appears (persistent aria-live=polite region)
on/off is announced by the switch role and its state, not by extra text

useCases.when: A setting that is on or off and takes effect at once, or is saved with the form
useCases.use: sb-switch with a label that names the setting

useCases.when: The effect or format needs explaining
Consent must be on before submit
useCases.use: required with a label that states the consent

antiPatterns.pattern: A choice that is only recorded and submitted later with other options
antiPatterns.why: Checkboxes record a choice; a switch reads as acting at once

antiPatterns.pattern: Choosing exactly one option from several
antiPatterns.why: A switch is one independent on/off value

antiPatterns.pattern: A label that flips with the state ("Enable" / "Disable")
antiPatterns.why: The switch role already announces on/off; a changing name is confusing
antiPatterns.alternative: A fixed label that names the setting

openQuestions.question: Contract content drafted with the contract-author skill (visual reference, WAI-ARIA APG)?
openQuestions.answer: Yes: the visual reference for look and sizes, the APG switch pattern, form behavior per the form-associated-controls rule.

openQuestions.question: Is checked reflected to an attribute?
openQuestions.answer: No. Same as Checkbox: the attribute is the default that form reset restores; checked is a property.

openQuestions.question: Is label required?
openQuestions.answer: Yes, like Checkbox and Input; hide-label keeps it as the accessible name.

openQuestions.question: Which sizes?
openQuestions.answer: Two, as in the visual reference: default and sm (medium and small in the API vocabulary, spec/api.json).

openQuestions.question: Native checkbox with role=switch, or a custom role=switch element?
openQuestions.answer: Native <input type=checkbox role=switch> inside the shadow root (SB-0007: native first; NativeControl wraps a native input).

openQuestions.question: Does the error use the same persistent live region as Checkbox?
openQuestions.answer: Yes, and an error sets a customError validity (SB-0009).

openQuestions.question: What does an on Switch submit?
openQuestions.answer: value (default "on") only while on; nothing while off, like a native checkbox.
